name: Chris Content Writer and AI Autoblogging Auto Posting for WordPress
author: Christopher Smith

sections.description:
Use AI for SEO optimized writing. This plugin creates long articles and posts up to 2,500 words. Ideal for autoblogging Google friendly content. Supports auto posting, content automation, and article generation. Perfect for affiliate blogging, automatic blog generator, SEO content creation, automated publishing workflows, content autopilot creator and one click article generation.

Key free version features:
* Manual “Generate Article” button for on demand content creation.
* Generates very long, detailed draft articles (up to 2,500 words) using the included prompt.
* Saves drafts for your review, editing, and publication.
* Compatible with WordPress >= 6.8 and PHP >= 7.0.

Can I get the Pro version without opening my wallet?
This plugin is the Lite version of Chris Content Writer and AI Autoblogging Auto Posting for WordPress Pro, which comes with very sophistigated automation enabling you to autopost for years without even lifting a finger and also without opening your wallet. See the FAQ for more information on this.

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API at https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions to generate article content. When you click Generate Article, it sends:
– Your OpenAI API key
– Your prompt text
– Model, max_tokens, and temperature settings

This service is provided by OpenAI, Inc.
– Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. In the WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Chris Content Writer and AI Autoblogging Auto Posting for WordPress”, or simply search for “Chris Content Writer”, click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Go to Settings → Chris Content Writer and AI Autoblogging Auto Posting for WordPress and configure:
    • OpenAI API Key
    • Manual Prompt (use the detailed example for best results)
    • OpenAI Model (recommend gpt-4o-mini)
    • Max Tokens (e.g. 12000–16000 for 2,500 word articles)
  3. Click Generate Article; drafts appear under Posts → Drafts. Review, edit, then publish as desired.
sections.faq:
Pro Version

How to upgrade to the Pro Version without opening my wallet?

See this page for details on how to get the Pro version without opening your wallet.

Can you tell me more about the Pro version?

Its biggest advantage is that writing and publishing is fully automated. However, you must first fill the topic library with topics. The more topics you add, the longer the plugin will continue writing and publishing without you lifting a finger. For example, if you fill the topic library with 365 topics and configure the settings to one article per day, the plugin will automatically write and publish for a year without you even pressing a button. Another special feature is that the upgraded plugin automatically adds relevant internal links and, if desired, external links as well. Finally, you can determine where the links are placed, how many there should be, and whether they should be dofollow or nofollow. The Pro version can be found on this page.

Free Version

Why are there no links in my articles?

The free version only generates articles without links. For fully automated internal and external link insertion, you can use the Pro version.

Why aren’t my articles publishing automatically?

The free version only generates drafts. For fully automated generation and publishing you can use the Pro version.

How long can generated articles be?

Up to 2,500 words using the included prompt example and sufficient max token settings.

Can I insert images or meta descriptions automatically?

No. You must add those manually in the editor.

What is the “magical prompt” and where do I find it?

A highly detailed instruction template included under Settings → Manual Prompt. Edit as desired, copy and paste it into the prompt field and save the settings.
